note: Converted from the pre-migration personal corpus's scripts/routing-corpus.json (positives/negatives) into harness's cases schema as part of the design plugin port. Re-derived 2026-07-06 for the color-contrast-facts extraction (T4 of the color-science split; see .claude/docs/color-science-extraction-plan.md). Positives span four phrasing classes: APCA/WCAG picks, contrast ratios/relative luminance, low-vision/readable color choices, CVD simulation/safe pairs; each class also carries an imperative/diagnostic/symptom/indirect mix. Negatives drawn adversarially from live neighbors: check-colors (verify/prove asks MUST NOT land here), check-focus (focus-ring contrast), color-space-facts (space/gamut math), color-perception-facts (vision science beyond CVD), physical-color-facts (pigment/print), make-palette (building), color-theory-facts (harmony). Reciprocals added 2026-07-09: measurement asks (check/verify a given pair or palette) belong to check-colors — third-strike confirmed boundary across three blind runs. KNOWN AMBIGUOUS SEAM (2026-07-09, 4 blind runs): t05/t06/t08/t10/t12 flip between this pack and check-colors/make-palette BY JUDGE. 2026-08-19 (issue #716, check-routing sweep #676) SUPERSEDES that acceptance for t05/t06/t10 specifically: the boundary is now decided — a single AD-HOC ratio/Lc computation between two given colors, or a one-off CVD simulation on a described palette with NO declared surface card, is this pack's claim; a full card-gated palette/mapping VERIFICATION producing a ColorProof is check-colors'. t08/t12 remain the accepted ambiguous seam (small generative asks), untouched by this decision. 2026-08-19 (#778, W2 diet): description trimmed 1196->698 chars; a scoped blind re-judge (25-skill menu) caught t12 ("give me a CVD-safe pair for error and success states") stolen by make-palette post-trim — added as an explicit CVD-safe-pick example (trimming (protanopia/deuteranopia) to hold budget). A second self-review caught that trim had also dropped the literal word "low-vision", risking t07/t08/t09 even though they route via the general "color-accessibility QUESTIONS" framing — restored "low-vision" to the opening clause, trimming "space/gamut"/"vision science" to "gamut"/"vision" elsewhere to hold the 700-char budget instead. t08 remains the one still-accepted ambiguous case, untouched. Zero new stolen/leaked/dead beyond t08's pre-existing status.
